dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: Oh dear... If you are posing a question like that to me, my star must have truly faded.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: My name is Dorofeya. I was a singer with the Korolevskiy Troupe for a few years.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: I suppose you can say I exited the spotlight early. These days, I am but a leisurely observer whiling my days away, courtesy of my husband's land holdings and a rather tiny income.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: It is also a distinct blessing to be here, far from the stage, lending my applause to those who have come after me like this.
